_meta.description: Wild/static encounter species per area key, derived by inverting the species->location column of https://unboundwiki.com/pokemon/ (facts only). No spawn rates. Time = day/night only where the wiki table says so.

cross_check_vs_nuzlocke_data.note: nuzlocke.data lists per-area species for 31+ areas; species it has that we lack are mostly explained by (a) its per-area merging of multi-form/evolution stages, (b) swarm/special/gift encounters we put in "special" or only in the dex how column, (c) wiki table abbreviations for multi-area species that we had to compress. Treat this file as best effort.

_meta.caveat: Some species list only a handful of areas in the wiki table. Starters/gifts/eggs/mystery gifts/post-game portals are NOT encounters here - see dex.json "how".
